# Sites

One directory per site, rendered from grid.yaml: edit grid.yaml, not these files.
Argo CD applies only `<site>/manifests`. `values.yaml` and `site.yaml` are render
inputs, and this README is not applied.

| Site | Cluster | Models |
|---|---|---|
| hq | local-cluster | Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B |
| factory | site-d | Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B |
| retail | site-e | qwen2.5-7b-instruct |

## hq

The hub. The OpenShift cluster that runs ACM and Argo CD, the grid's enrollment service and CA, and the consumer gateway: the front door at grid.acme.lab, or behind the MaaS gateway at maas.acme.lab. It also serves Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B from two llm-d pools, hq-east and hq-west, and hosts the lab's logs and dashboards. swim.hq is every site's membership seed.

## factory

A provider site on k3s. It serves Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B from one llm-d pool on two T4 GPUs. hq reaches its gateway at gw.factory.acme.lab over grid mTLS.

## retail

A provider site on single-node OpenShift. It serves qwen2.5-7b-instruct, which no other site serves, so requests for that model always cross the grid. hq reaches its gateway at gw.retail.acme.lab over grid mTLS.
